# IEEE Formula Speech Fallback Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use `superpowers:executing-plans` to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Render each IEEE formula as the existing Codecogs SVG and append a readable spoken-text fallback generated by Codecogs.

**Architecture:** Keep the existing `formulaToImage(doc)` image conversion and source extraction unchanged. Add a small `formulaSpeech(tex, java, cache)` helper that requests `mathml.latex`, parses its `span.cc-speech`, and caches the extracted text by TeX source. The existing `.notranslate` span continues to contain the readable formula text, so it is not translated again by `TC()`.

**Tech Stack:** Legado JavaScript rule engine, Jsoup, Codecogs `svg.latex` and `mathml.latex` HTTP endpoints.

## Global Constraints

- Keep the current `https://latex.codecogs.com/svg.latex?` image rendering URL.
- Use `https://latex.codecogs.com/mathml.latex?` only to retrieve the `span.cc-speech` text.
- Cache speech by the exact TeX string; failed or empty responses fall back to existing `span.mi` text.
- Keep the speech text visible in the existing `.notranslate` span.
- Do not deploy to the phone or create a git commit as part of this work.

### Task 2: Add cached Codecogs speech extraction

**Files:**
- Modify: `ieee_back.json` — `ruleContent.content`, immediately before `formulaToImage(doc)`.
- Test: `/tmp/opencode/validate_ieee_formula_speech.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: nonempty `tex`, Legado `java.ajax`, and `cache`.
- Produces: `formulaSpeech(tex, java, cache)`, returning a string or `""`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Add the helper**

```javascript
function formulaSpeech(tex, java, cache) {
    var cacheKey = 'codecogs_speech:' + tex;
    var cached = cache.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached != null) return String(cached);
    try {
        var response = java.ajax(
            'https://latex.codecogs.com/mathml.latex?' + encodeURIComponent(tex)
        );
        var speechDoc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(response || ''));
        var speech = String(speechDoc.select('span.cc-speech').text()).trim();
        if (speech) cache.put(cacheKey, speech, 2592000);
        return speech;
    } catch (e) {
        java.log('公式朗读文本获取失败: ' + e);
        return '';
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Replace only the span text source**

```javascript
var speechText = formulaSpeech(tex, java, cache);
if (speechText || miText) {
    var spanEl = doc.createElement('span');
    spanEl.addClass('notranslate');
    spanEl.text(' ' + (speechText || miText) + ' ');
    imgEl.after(spanEl);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Run the focused contract test and verify it passes**

Run: `python3 /tmp/opencode/validate_ieee_formula_speech.py`

Expected: `IEEE formula speech contract passed`.
